The [[Dynastic Tombs]] are ancient [[Primeval Kings]] burial grounds of a kingdom swallowed by [[the Desolation]] and remembered only by the spirits of the dead.

==Getting there==
The [[Remains of Sahlahja]] [[challenge mission]] takes place here. As such, the only method of gaining entry is by attempting that mission.

==Exits==
None.

==NPCs==
See [[Remains of Sahlahja#NPCs]] for more information, since the NPCs here are all due to the mission.

==Notes==
*When in here, your character will have the [[Corrupted Lands]] effect.
*Complete exploration of this area will yield about 1.8% to the Elonian Cartographer title track.
